marc:datafield.marc:subfield: திறந்திடு சிஸேம் : அரிய பொக்கிஷங்களின் அபூர்வ வரலாறு! | Thiranthidu Sesame : Ariya Pokkisaṅkalin Apurva Varalaru!

"Thirandhidu Seesam" explores the timeless human fascination with treasures and hidden artifacts. From ancient times to the present, the quest for valuable gems, rare books, and buried riches has captivated imaginations and spurred adventures. This book delves into the history of extraordinary treasures, including priceless jewels, historic coins, and precious artifacts concealed by royalty and wealthy individuals. With an engaging and lively narrative, author Mukil brings these captivating stories to life, offering readers a treasure trove of wonder and discovery. Just as saying "Open Sesame" unlocks a world of riches, this book promises to unveil a wealth of surprises and intrigue.
